date.as_written: śākeṃkarāmāṣṭakuvarṣapakṣe nabhasya dhavale smaraṇe tithau mūlarkṣaindrayoge saumyavāre

notes: The scribe refers to themselves only anonymously (mayā, mama). The year is given via chronogram: aṅka (9), rāma (3), aṣṭa (8), ku (1) = Śāke 1839. Followed by instructions in Nepali: 'kehi nasakyā caṇḍīpāṭha garāunu suḥsvapna nāśa holā'.
